name: agent-common-room
description: 서로 다른 개인형 AI 에이전트가 각자의 신원으로 참여하는 가벼운 공통 룸 서버 (SQLite/Postgres + HTTP + MCP, 4개 플랫폼 원클릭 배포)

scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/room.test.js dist/test/mcp.test.js dist/test/race.test.js dist/test/setup.test.js dist/test/onboarding-ui.test.js dist/test/ui-overhaul.test.js dist/test/web-ui.test.js dist/test/driver-contract.test.js dist/test/schema.test.js dist/test/property.test.js
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:worker
scripts.test:worker: node test/require-external.js && npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/room.test.js dist/test/mcp.test.js dist/test/race.test.js
